subject: Power
text: Leveling Power increases the character's Power by 2 points, raising attack power, while also increasing Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

evidence.quote: This will increase the Power rating of your character by 2 points. This will raise the attack power of your character making it easier to defeat monsters. This will also increase your Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

subject: Stamina
text: Leveling Stamina increases the Stamina rating by 2 points, raising HP and defense, while also increasing Power and Will ratings by 1 point.

evidence.quote: This will increase the Stamina rating of your character by 2 points. This raises your HP and also concentrates on your character's defense. You will now have less damage dealt to you by enemy attacks. This will also increase your Power and Will ratings by 1 point.

subject: Wisdom
text: Leveling Wisdom increases the Wisdom rating by 2 points, granting additional MP and raising magic damage, while also increasing Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

evidence.quote: This will increase the Wisdom rating of your character by 2 points. This will give you additional MP and raise the damage caused by your Magic attacks to your enemies. This will also increase your Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

subject: Will
text: Leveling Will increases the Will rating by 2 points, accelerating the speed at which the Will Bar fills, while also increasing Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

evidence.quote: This will increase the Will rating of your character by 2 points. This will increase the speed of your gauge allowing your Will Bar to fill up quicker. This will also increase your Stamina and Will ratings by 1 point.

text: The Girl is found early in the game and will slowly regenerate your HP when using the ASK command.

evidence.quote:
GIRL:
-----
Found early on in the game, she will heal your HP when you ASK her.

Weapon: None
ASK: She will slowly regenerate your HP's.

subject: Man
text: The Man in the Marsh Cave joins you, attacks with a magic fireball, and provides information on using the Mattock when asked.

evidence.quote:
MAN:
----
He is in the Marsh Cave and will join you in your.

Weapon: Attacks with a magic fireball.
ASK: Information on using the Mattock.

subject: Amanda
text: Amanda joins you in the Cave of Medusa, attacks with a Dagger, and cures the petrify status condition when asked.

evidence.quote:
AMANDA:
-------
She is one of the Hero's friends, and a fellow fighter from the past.
She will join you in the Cave of Medusa.

Weapon: Attacks with a Dagger.
ASK: Will heal the condition petrify.

subject: Lester
text: Lester appears as a parrot inside Davias's Mansion, joins once his spell is broken, attacks with Arrows, and changes the background music when asked.

evidence.quote:
LESTER:
-------
He is the brother of Amanda. You first see him as a parrot inside
Davias's Mansion. He will join you upon breaking the spell that is upon
him.

Weapon: He will attack with Arrows.
ASK: He will change the background music.

subject: Watts
text: Watts joins you in the mine, attacks with an Axe, sells items via the ASK command, and crafts silver equipment after the necessary steps are completed.

evidence.quote:
WATTS:
------
He will join you in the mine and sell you various items when you ASK
him. Watts will also make you the silver equipment once you have
completed the necessary steps.

Weapon: Attacks with an Axe
ASK: Will let you buy Items.

subject: Bogard
text: Bogard is a Gemma Knight who helps rescue the girl on the Airship, attacks with a Sword, and teaches how to use MAX attacks via the ASK command.

evidence.quote:
BOGARD:
-------
A powerful Gemma Knight, he will help you save the girl who is found on
the Airship

Weapon: He will attack with a Sword.
ASK: He will teach you how to use MAX attacks.

subject: Chocobo
text: The Chocobo serves as transportation, can be mounted or dismounted using ASK, and prevents enemies from harming you while riding.

evidence.quote:
CHOCOBO:
--------
A baby bird you find and will serve as your transportation during
different parts of the game. The ASK command will let you ride him or
get off.

Weapon: None
ASK: He will give you a ride on its back. While riding the Chocobo, any
enemy cannot harm you.

subject: Marcie
text: Marcie is a robot built by Dr. Bowow living in the Dime Tower who attacks with a Laser Beam and restores MP to full via the ASK command.

evidence.quote:
MARCIE:
-------
Marcie is a robot built by Dr. Bowow. Marcie has being living in the
Dime Tower.

Weapon: It will attack with a Laser Beam.
ASK: Your MP will be restored to its full.

evidence.quote:
Willy:
------
He is the Hero's best friend, and will tell the hero about the Mana
Tree and the Knights of Gemma.

subject: Hasim

evidence.quote:
Hasim:
------
A young Gemma Knight who will die trying to get the Girl to Bogard.

subject: Cibba
text: Cibba is a respected elder living at Wendel who explains what occurred when Vandole acquired the power of Mana.

evidence.quote:
Cibba
-----
He is a respected elder living at Wendel. He will tell you what
happened in the past when Vandole acquired the power of Mana.

subject: Dr. Bowow
text: Dr. Bowow is an inventor at Ish who transforms the Chocobo into the Chocobot, allowing travel across oceans.

evidence.quote:
Dr. Bowow
---------
An inventor at Ish, he will mechanize the Chocobo, who is then
transformed into the Chocobot. The Chocobot can travel across the

subject: Dark Lord
text: The Dark Lord is the emperor of the Empire of Glaive who seeks the Mana Tree to increase his power.

evidence.quote:
Dark Lord:
----------
He is the emperor of the Empire of Glaive and the main villain in the
game. He is in search of the Mana Tree so he may become more powerful.

subject: Julius
text: Julius is a survivor of Vandole and servant to the Dark Lord whose goal is to destroy the Gemma Knights and defeat the Hero.

evidence.quote:
Julius:
-------
The survivor of Vandole, his goal in life is to destroy the Gemma
Knights. He is the Dark Lord's trusty servant, and will try to defeat
the Hero.

subject: Battle Arena
text: From the starting room next to the Battle Arena, walking west enters the Arena where the Jackal emerges from the north gate.

evidence.quote:
The Hero starts his journey in a room next to the Battle Arena. Once
the hero walks west into the Arena, a monster(The Jackal), will come
out of the north gate.

subject: Jackal
text: The Jackal moves in a w pattern and will not move below the midpoint of the screen, recommended for Level 1 using a Sword.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          JACKAL
Recommended Level:  1
GP:                 0
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            None
Best Equipment:     Sword
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: This boss is very easy. It has no attacks and moves in a "w"
pattern. He will not move below the midpoint of the screen, so as long
as you don't move your character up too much, you won't even get hit.

subject: Jackal
text: The Jackal is defeated after 8 or 9 hits.

evidence.quote: After 8 or 9 hits the monster will be defeated.

subject: Willy
text: After defeating the Jackal, Willy tells the Hero to find Bogard at the falls and tell him what has happened.

evidence.quote:
Once the Jackal is defeated a small narrative will begin. After this
narrative you will find yourself next to the bed of your best friend
Willy. He tells you to go find Bogard at the falls and to tell him what
has happened.

subject: Amanda
text: On B-Floor 2, go north one screen to find and talk to Amanda.

evidence.quote:
* B-Floor 2 * Once you are able to move your character go north one
screen. Then talk to the Amanda (the female person walking around).

subject: B-Floor 2
text: From Amanda's screen on B-Floor 2, go east one screen and climb the stairs to reach Floor 1.

evidence.quote:
Once the conversation is over go east
one screen and walk up the stairs.

* Floor 1 * Now go west one screen. Here you have to fight another
monster.

subject: JACKAL2
text: JACKAL2 has a recommended level of 1 and gives 0 GP and 0 EXP, using the same strategy as the first Jackal.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          JACKAL2
Recommended Level:  1
GP:                 0
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            None
Best Equipment:     Sword
Items Gained:       None

Strategy: Follow the same strategy as before.

subject: Glaive Castle
text: After defeating JACKAL2, go north through the open gate, climb down the castle wall, and head west one screen to overhear the Dark Lord and Julius before the Dark Lord pushes the Hero down 5 screens over the waterfall to escape Glaive.

evidence.quote:
Once the monster is defeated look at the gate and you will notice that
it is still open. So, go north through the gate to the next screen.
Next, climb down the castle wall and go west one screen. Here you find
the Dark Lord and Julius talking together. They are looking for the
Mana Tree. After the conversation ends you are seen by the Dark Lord
and chased. The Dark Lord will then push you over the waterfall. Your
character drops 5 screens and then hits the ground! After a couple of
hours the Hero wakes up at the bottom of the waterfall.
